name: SUPAX
summary: A superconducting-cavity axion-search project that first tests dark-photon and axion signal readout with a copper-cavity prototype.
detection_principle: A magnetized cavity converts axions to microwaves; the same low-noise radio-frequency system also measures dark-photon conversion signals in the cavity.

status.label: Prototype with published axion-search results; full instrument under development
status.evidence: The collaboration's 2026 prototype paper reports a copper cavity at 2 K searching for approximately 34 μeV axions in a 12 T field.

results.summary: The prototype sets upper limits on axion–photon coupling and dark-photon mixing; the future superconducting instrument's coverage is a design goal.
The prototype search near 34 μeV reached axion–photon sensitivity of 1.6×10⁻¹³ GeV⁻¹; the same data also constrain dark photons.

science_scope: Directly searches for Galactic-halo axions, axionlike particles or other ultralight dark matter. Limits depend on assumed local density, velocity distribution and coupling models; separate scanned mass intervals do not amount to exclusion of the entire range.
